headline.purpose: Page titles, the feedback verdict, the revealed answer.

title.purpose: Unit bands, node cards, cards and sheets.

question.purpose: The question text in a lesson.

body-large.purpose: Leads under titles and on celebration screens, 60ch max.

math-display.purpose: The current question's expression, KaTeX, always LTR.

celebration-numerals.purpose: Streak count Fredoka 700 76px/80px; combo pop Fredoka 700 44px/52px. Off the ramp by design.

shadows.name: lip
shadows.purpose: Buttons and answer choices; collapses to 0 with translateY(4px) on press.

shadows.name: lip-small
shadows.purpose: Keypad keys, segmented options, the grade switch.

shadows.name: lip-border
shadows.purpose: Pressable cards and banners, the lesson's answer slots.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: sheets, the node card, the jump-back button.

shadows.name: shadow-dock
shadows.purpose: Bottom docks on the older practice screens.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Feedback panel rise, combo count fade, sheet backdrop.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Progress bar width, ring segment fill, sheet entry.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Idle loops: start bubble bob (1.6s), mascot bob (2.6s), flame (1.8s).

motion.name: error-shake
motion.purpose: Answer row after a wrong answer.

motion.name: ring-fill-delay
motion.purpose: Delay before the earned lesson segment fills on return to the path.

motion.name: think-shimmer (exception)
motion.purpose: AI thinking line only; not a reusable device.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Celebrations, bobs, shimmer, panel rise and ring fill stop under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one big action (check, continue, start): indigo block on a deep-indigo lip that sinks on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--brand, #5b4ff0); background: var(--brand, #5b4ff0); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--brand-d, #3f33c4); margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'Fredoka Variable', 'Fredoka', 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 280px; } .ds-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #5b4ff0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--brand-d, #3f33c4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White block on a grey lip with indigo text, for the second choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--rule-strong, #c9cad9); background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--brand-d, #3f33c4); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--rule-press, #d9dae6); margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'Fredoka Variable', 'Fredoka', 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #5b4ff0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--rule-press, #d9dae6); }

components.name: Answer Choice
components.description: Chunky choice block with a key badge; selected indigo, correct green, wrong red and struck.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', 'Rubik', sans-serif; } .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 60px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: start; border: 2px solid var(--rule, #e6e6f0); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--paper, #fff); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--rule-press, #d9dae6); margin-bottom: 4px; font: inherit; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #24253a); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand, #5b4ff0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--rule-press, #d9dae6); } .ds-key { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 2px solid var(--rule, #e6e6f0); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2, #5f6178); } .ds-choice.on { border-color: #b9b3ff; background: var(--brand-tint, #ecebff); color: var(--brand-d, #3f33c4); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #b9b3ff; } .ds-choice.good { border-color: var(--good, #1f9d55); background: var(--good-tint, #dff6e7); color: var(--good-ink, #157a41); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #9fdcb7; } .ds-choice.bad { border-color: #ffb3c3; background: var(--bad-tint, #ffe6ec); color: var(--bad-ink, #c01d43); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #ffc9d5; text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Path Coins
components.description: Round coins on a 7px lip: unit colour for the current step (with lesson ring), gold when done, grey when locked.
components.css: .ds-path { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 12px; } .ds-slot { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 112px; height: 112px; } .ds-ring { position: absolute; inset: 0; } .ds-node { --c: var(--ch-sky, #1a8fd6); --c-d: var(--ch-sky-d, #0d6ba8); position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 70px; height: 70px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 7px 0 var(--c-d); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-node.cur { width: 76px; height: 76px; } .ds-node:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--c); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-node:active { transform: translateY(7px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--c-d); } .ds-node.done { --c: var(--gold, #f5b400); --c-d: var(--gold-d, #d39600); color: #6b4500; } .ds-node.locked { --c: #e4e5ee; --c-d: #c9cad9; color: #a3a5bb; }

components.css: .ds-fb { --bg: var(--good-tint, #dff6e7); --line: #b4e8c8; --ink: var(--good-ink, #157a41); --mark: var(--good, #1f9d55); --mark-d: var(--good-d, #16803f); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-top: 2px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); font-family: 'Rubik Variable', 'Rubik', sans-serif; animation: ds-fb-rise 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-fb.bad { --bg: var(--bad-tint, #ffe6ec); --line: #ffc9d5; --ink: var(--bad-ink, #c01d43); --mark: var(--bad, #e5375a); --mark-d: var(--bad-d, #b8213f); } .ds-fb-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-fb-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: var(--mark); } .ds-fb-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fredoka Variable', 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; line-height: 36px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-fb-btn { min-height: 54px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--mark); background: var(--mark); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--mark-d); margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'Fredoka Variable', 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-fb-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-fb-btn:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--mark-d); } @keyframes ds-fb-rise { from { transform: translateY(24px); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-fb { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Madregot means stairs, and the whole system is a staircase a student climbs a few steps of every day. The ground is plain white, the ink a soft navy, and everything the thumb can press is a chunky, rounded block standing on a solid lip that sinks when pressed. A winding path of round coins carries the student from lesson to lesson; each topic is a unit with its own chapter colour; the mascot מדי, an indigo two-step stair block with a face, stands beside the next step and reacts to every answer.

The loop is Duolingo's (path, one big check button, a green or red panel after every answer, streak, XP) with its own identity: electric indigo instead of green as the brand, Fredoka and Rubik instead of a proprietary face, a stair block instead of an owl. The density is phone-first and generous: 44px minimum targets, one question per screen, the action dock within thumb reach. Colour is loud but semantic; every saturated hue has exactly one job.

The genre's pressure devices are absent by design and stay absent: no hearts or energy meters, no global league tables, no guilt-tinted states. A mistake is shown, crossed out and explained, never charged for. Shabbat is drawn as a calm rest day in the streak week, never as a break.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, soft navy ink, electric indigo for action and selection.
Semantic colour: green right, red not yet, orange streak, gold XP and finished nodes.
Five chapter colours (sky, fuchsia, petrol, cobalt, violet), one per unit.
Chunky pressable controls on a solid lip that collapses on press; nothing else gets a lip.
Fredoka for the voice (headings, buttons, numbers), Rubik for reading, serif KaTeX for math, always LTR.
Hebrew RTL throughout, phone-first, with a side rail and side panel from 960px.
Short exponential ease-out motion; celebrations only after an answer, skippable, off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green means right, red means not yet, orange means streak, gold means XP and finished. No chapter colour is green, orange or gold, and none of the four is used for decoration.

rules.name: The Ink Value Rule
rules.body: Fills may be light; text always takes an "-ink" or "-d" value (4.5:1 or more on its tint or on white). White text sits only on brand, good, bad and "-d" chapter fills.

rules.name: The Indigo Acts Rule
rules.body: Indigo is where the student acts or has chosen: the primary button, the selected option, the active tab, focus. It never marks correctness.

rules.name: The Rounded Voice Rule
rules.body: Fredoka speaks (headings, buttons, counts, stats); Rubik explains (questions, body, labels). Questions are Rubik so long Hebrew sentences stay readable.

rules.name: The LTR Math Rule
rules.body: Every expression is KaTeX in its own left-to-right isolate, and a short inline expression never splits across lines inside Hebrew text.

rules.name: The Lip Means Press Rule
rules.body: A lip promises that something can be pressed, and pressing collapses it. Static content (stat tiles, plain cards, the feedback panel, chips) sits flat with a 2px rule.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Blurred shadows are for layers above the page (sheets, the node card); nothing at rest on the page casts one.

dos: Do put every primary action in one full-width indigo button on its lip, within thumb reach in the bottom dock.
Do give anything pressable a lip that collapses on press (translate by the lip, 80ms ease-out), and nothing else.
Do keep each meaning colour to its one job: green right, red not yet, orange streak, gold XP and done nodes.
Do colour a unit's coins, ring, band and level line from its chapter colour, with text in the "-d" value.
Do set headings, buttons and counts in Fredoka 600, questions and text in Rubik, math in KaTeX inside an LTR isolate.
Do keep a wrong answer visible, struck through in red ink, next to the hint.
Do play celebrations (combo pop, mascot cheer, streak tick) only after an answer, let a tap skip them, and switch them off under reduced motion.
Do keep targets at 44px or more and text at 4.5:1 or more.
donts: Don't use Duolingo's green as the brand, or its owl, name, typeface or art.
Don't draw hearts, lives or energy meters, global or league leaderboards, or guilt-tinted states.
Don't draw Shabbat as a missed or broken day in the streak.
Don't make a chapter colour green, orange or gold, or use those colours decoratively.
Don't put a lip or a blurred shadow on static content (stat tiles, plain cards, the feedback panel, chips).
Don't nest a card inside the feedback panel; the tutor's note is text under a rule.
Don't use gradient-clipped text outside the AI thinking line.
